```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

results_spaMM_districts$region <- c(rep("Dosso",8),rep("Tahoua",7))

order_of_distr <- c(9,10,1,11,2:6,12,13,7,14,15,8) #alphabetical order of districts

d_sf %>% group_by(region, district) %>% summarise()

```


```{r map predictions - tx0}
#------------------------------------------------------
# create and save mortality rate maps
# for control arm (tx=0)
# (see function in 0-functions-analysis.R)

# NOW, we loop through each district and make maps
#------------------------------------------------------

for (i in 1:15) {
  
  #NOTE: raster2 names are flipped -- need to debug before publishing code
  tempmap <- create_mort_map_districts(raster2 = results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1[[i]], 
                agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                tagtxt  = districts[i],
                min = 0,
                max = 48,
                interval = 12,
                paletteopt = 1,
                distr = districts[i],
                legtxt = "Mortality per 1000 person-years",
                include_axes_labs = T,
                include_legend = T)
  
  results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[i]] <- tempmap
}

# Sort them in new list for mapping
plots_tx0_sorted <- vector("list", length(order_of_distr))
plots_tx0_sorted <- list(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[9]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[10]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[1]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[11]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[2]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[3]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[4]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[5]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[6]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[12]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[13]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[7]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[14]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[15]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[[8]])

# Plot using patchwork function.
map_tx0_sorted_all   <- wrap_plots(plots_tx0_sorted,
                                   ncol = 4,
                                   widths = 0.8)

map_tx0_unsorted_all <- wrap_plots(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0, 
                                   ncol = 4, 
                                   widths = 0.8)

map_tx0_Dosso <- wrap_plots(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[results_spaMM_districts$region=="Dosso"], 
                                   ncol = 4, 
                                   widths = 0.8)

map_tx0_Tahoua <- wrap_plots(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_tx0[results_spaMM_districts$region=="Tahoua"], 
                                   ncol = 4, 
                                   widths = 0.8)

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels-district/map_pred_tx0_Dosso-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       map_tx0_Dosso,
       device = "pdf",
       width = 12,
       height = 8,
       units = "in")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels-district/map_pred_tx0_Tahoua-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       map_tx0_Tahoua,
       device = "pdf",
       width = 12,
       height = 8,
       units = "in")

```

```{r map predictions - diff}
#------------------------------------------------------
# create and save mortality rate maps
# for ATE (tx1 - tx0)
# (see function in 0-functions-analysis.R)

# NOW, we loop through each district and make maps
#------------------------------------------------------

for (i in 1:15) {
  
  min_diff_dist <- min(as.data.frame(results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_diff[results_spaMM_districts$district==districts[i]])$value, na.rm=T)
  max_diff_dist <- max(as.data.frame(results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_diff[results_spaMM_districts$district==districts[i]])$value, na.rm=T)
  
  print(min_diff_dist)
  print(max_diff_dist)
  print("/")
    
  tempmap_diff <- create_mort_map_districts(
     raster2 = results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_diff[[i]],
     agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
     tagtxt  = districts[i],
     # min = -17, max = 5, ##option 1: same scale for all plots
     min = floor(min_diff_dist), max=ceiling(max_diff_dist), ##option 2: distr have their own scale
     
     ## option 3: 0-5 for ATE>0, -17-0 for ATE<0
     # min = ifelse(districts[i] %in% c("Boboye","Madaoua"), 0,
     #              floor(min(unlist(results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_diff),
     #                         na.rm=T))
     #              ),
     # max = ifelse(districts[i] %in% c("Boboye","Madaoua"), 5, 0),
     interval = 1,
     paletteopt = 2,
     distr = districts[i],
     legtxt = "Mortality per 1000 person-years",
     include_axes_labs = T,
     include_legend = T)
  
  results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[i]] <- tempmap_diff
}

# Sort them in new list for mapping
plots_diff_sorted <- vector("list", length(order_of_distr))
plots_diff_sorted <- list(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[9]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[10]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[1]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[11]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[2]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[3]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[4]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[5]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[6]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[12]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[13]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[7]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[14]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[15]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[[8]])

# Plot using patchwork function.
map_diff_sorted_all   <- wrap_plots(plots_diff_sorted,
                                   ncol = 4,
                                   widths = 0.8)

map_diff_unsorted_all <- wrap_plots(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff, 
                                   ncol = 4, 
                                   widths = 0.8)

map_diff_Dosso <- wrap_plots(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[results_spaMM_districts$region=="Dosso"], 
                                   ncol = 4, 
                                   widths = 0.8)

map_diff_Tahoua <- wrap_plots(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_diff[results_spaMM_districts$region=="Tahoua"], 
                                   ncol = 4, 
                                   widths = 0.8)

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels-district/map_pred_diff_Dosso-2-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       map_diff_Dosso,
       device = "pdf",
       width = 12,
       height = 8,
       units = "in")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels-district/map_pred_diff_Tahoua-2-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       map_diff_Tahoua,
       device = "pdf",
       width = 12,
       height = 8,
       units = "in")

```

```{r map predictions - probeff}
#------------------------------------------------------
# create and save mortality rate maps
# for Posterior Pr(ATE < 0)
# (see function in 0-functions-analysis.R)

# NOW, we loop through each district and make maps
#------------------------------------------------------

for (i in 1:15) {
  
  tempmap_probeff <- create_mort_map_districts(raster2 = results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_probeff[[i]],
               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
               tagtxt  = districts[i],
               min = 0,
               max = ceiling(max(unlist(results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_probeff), na.rm=T))+2,
               interval = 12,
               paletteopt = 1,
               distr = districts[i],
               legtxt = "Mortality per 1000 person-years",
               include_axes_labs = T,
               include_legend = F)
  
  results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[i]] <- tempmap_probeff
}

# Sort them in new list for mapping
reordered_plots_probeff <- vector("list", length(order_of_distr))
reordered_plots_probeff <- list(results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[9]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[10]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[1]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[11]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[2]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[3]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[4]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[5]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[6]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[12]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[13]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[7]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[14]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[15]],
                         results_spaMM_districts$map_pred_probeff[[8]])

# Plot using patchwork function.
wrap_plots(reordered_plots_probeff, 
           nrow = 4, widths = 0.8)

```
